note: Source of truth for talks, trainings, webinars and community sessions. Photos are NOT public source: full-size originals live in assets/img/engagements/<slug>/ and web derivatives are generated by tools/optimise-engagements.py. To add a talk: add an entry here, drop photos in assets/img/engagements/<slug>/ (cover.jpg + 01.jpg…), then run `python3 tools/optimise-engagements.py <slug>`. Every photograph in the folder is published by default; set "gallery": ["01","12",…] only to curate. Entries with "listed_only": true appear in the track record without a photo card.
